title: Jev Cookbook fixture files
description: Row schemas for a recipe's fixtures/inputs.jsonl and fixtures/labels.jsonl. The responses file is not described here: it is the replay format defined by jev_cookbook.ReplayBackend (see docs/backends.md). See docs/fixtures.md.

input.description: One line of inputs.jsonl: one example.

id.description: Stable identifier, unique in the recipe, shared with labels.jsonl.

split.description: train (optional), validation, test, or demo (illustration only, no label needed).

state.description: The exact state passed to backend.decide: text, a JSON object, or an array of strings.

fields.description: The values the recipe's Python builds the state from. Use this instead of state when the recipe assembles the state.

replay_keys.description: replay_key(state, questions) of every request made for this example, as 64 lowercase hex characters. More than one when a later request depends on an earlier answer.

label.description: One line of labels.jsonl: the gold label of one example.

id.description: The id of the example this labels.

label.description: The gold label. Any JSON value except null: a string, a number, a boolean, a list, or an object (for several labels).
